title: Case: Recipient requests a call shortly before arrival
context: The route is booked, but the customer needs time to move from a nearby studio to the delivery door. The driver has not yet departed.
initial_request: Could the driver call shortly before reaching me? I work in the studio next door and need a few minutes to walk over. Use my saved order contact.

events.body: DL-1359 is on the 2027-02-05 afternoon route. For this route we can add a call request using the verified number already in the order record; we cannot guarantee an exact advance interval.
